title: mos.features.v1
description: Raw MMC feature list emitted by `mos features --json`: one GET CONFIGURATION (RT=0) reply, one entry per feature descriptor in reply order. This is the medium-writability surface: a write feature's `current` flag answers whether the drive can write the medium mounted right now (e.g. code 0x0041 current with a blank BD-R inserted), complementing mos.metadata.v1's disc-side blank status. Codes are MMC feature numbers (MMC-6 §5.3); mos ships no name table — mapping is consumer-side. Deliberately carries NO current_profile: the state path's profile-only-on-READY rule (ARCHITECTURE §9) exists because drives cache stale profiles, and this document must not provide a bypass. Feature payloads are not exposed; payload facts go public as typed fields (mos.drive.v1 capabilities is the template).

bsd.description: Whole-disk dev node of the current media, or null when the drive is empty. The current flags are a function of this medium.

registry_id.description: Drive service IORegistry entry ID (attachment identity). 0 = unavailable.

features.description: Reply order preserved. May be empty only on a degenerate reply (the walker fails closed on malformed descriptors, ending the list early rather than emitting attacker-shaped entries).

current.description: Descriptor byte 2 bit 0: feature active for the currently mounted medium.

persistent.description: Descriptor byte 2 bit 1: feature always active regardless of medium.
